source.title: Square-1 attempt was identified as misscramble (extra not available)
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation [11i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11i) has been updated to provide stricter criteria for when a misscramble should receive an extra.

After the competition, a Square-1 attempt was identified as misscramble.
As an extra was not available and due to the fact that the misscramble was easier than the official scramble, the WRC decided to DNF the attempt.

translation.title: Square-1 被认定使用错误打乱（无额外尝试）
translation.content:
说明：此事件处理后，[11i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11i) 已更新，对错误打乱何时应获额外尝试设定了更严格的标准。

赛后发现，某次 Square-1 尝试使用了错误打乱。由于无法提供额外尝试，且该错误打乱比正式打乱简单，WRC 决定将该次尝试判为 DNF。
